findings: Composer's program note reproduced by Duo Cuypers/Lop explicitly says it was written in summer 1997 for Carola Cuypers, alto saxophone, and Enrique M.Lop, guitar.
The note describes deliberately integrated instrumental roles, with the saxophone restraining its projection and the guitar taking a more assertive role.
Duo repertoire list gives world premiere May 1998. Their album Dutch Music for Saxophone and Guitar, ErasmusWVH237, includes the work.
